description: This file defines an interface for a grain in an Orleans-based project, specifically for testing stateless worker scaling behavior.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerScalingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that supports stateless worker scaling, with methods to wait, release, and retrieve activation/waiting counts.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Asynchronously waits, possibly for a signal or event.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the grain, marked with AlwaysInterleave attribute.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of activations of this grain.

methods.name: GetWaitingCount
methods.description: Returns the current waiting count for this grain.
